text:
Palladium Price in 1992
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1992, the LBMA palladium price rose 22.8% between 1992-01-31 ($86.50) and 1992-12-30 ($106). The highest sampled price was $106 in December and the lowest was $80.50 in May. The mean of these observations was $89.14. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
